title: eludite.solution.remove_folder input
description: Remove on a solution folder (brief 0081): the folder, its sub-folders and solution items leave the solution file, and so do its projects (their files stay on disk), as in Visual Studio.

folder.description: A solution folder: its path from the solution root (/src/, /src/tests/) as eludite.solution.tree and the Workspace window name it, or its name when that is unique.
